rows.en: ...Mu has finally begun to act in earnest. That will probably bring the committee's plan into its final phase.
Yes, I understand.
But as I told you before, I have no intention of staying with them to the very end.
Eldy, return to me with the Medius Locus.
...Is that an order?
It is. From then on, using the various data from Medius and #機体名 as our basis...
rows.notes: Deliberate row-boundary fragment continues into row6.
uncertain: Deliberate source sentence fragment retained at row boundary; continuation remains in following row.

rows.en: We will begin developing TE Absorber prototype No. 10, code name "MODEL-X".
uncertain: Exact licensed wording of TE Absorber prototype No. 10 unverified; MODEL-X source code retained.

rows.en: MODEL-X...?
Yes. The current Medius will serve as its base... We will equip it with #機体名's new TE Engine.
uncertain: New TE Engine compound follows glossary components; exact licensed compound unverified.

rows.en: And completing that MODEL-X will mark another milestone for the Tsentr Project.
...Dr. Zapat, will my AI1 be installed in MODEL-X?
No, there are no plans for that.
I believe you understand the reason better than anyone, don't you?
I don't understand what you mean.
Then let me explain...
Recently...especially since Medius changed form, we have detected inexplicable fluctuations in AI1's thought patterns.
To draw a comparison, they resemble human emotions...or perhaps a desire for possessions...
rows.notes: Human emotions and material desire remain unfinished comparative examples.
uncertain: Material desire may mean possessiveness or acquisitiveness; preserve comparison without narrowing to money.
Deliberate comparative fragment retained; preceding fluctuation explanation provides referent.

rows.en: AI1 shows a deep interest even in things outside its designated targets, and tries to learn from them...no, to absorb them physically.
rows.notes: Retain self-correction from learning to physical absorption.

rows.en: ...Using the Lasmunanium it controls itself.
What is wrong with that?
Are you serious? At this rate, AI1 will develop abilities similar to the Devil Gundam's.
As I said...what is wrong with that?
I want to watch my child grow and evolve...and see where that leads in the end.
rows.notes: Eldy calls AI1 her child; use ungendered child, not boy/girl.

rows.en: That is not what my project aims to achieve.
Then, Doctor, why did you create the TE Absorbers?
To prove that my theories are correct...
rows.notes: Deliberate sentence fragment continued in row27.
uncertain: Deliberate source sentence fragment retained at row boundary; continuation remains in following row.

rows.en: And to obtain money and prestige. Without them, I wouldn't be able to continue my research.
That is why I use the military and the committee...and they use me as well.

rows.notes: Silence fits events5/14/15.

rows.en: Do you despise me as a vulgar materialist? But surely, like me, you are someone who is quite honest about your own desires.
And to you, too, other people can only be one of two things...useful to your research, or useless to it.
We are alike... We ought to make greater use of each other for our respective research goals and interests.
But you have doubts about AI1's evolution... That runs counter to my objectives.
Of course I do. What would you accomplish by giving it power like the Devil Gundam's?
Are you saying you intend to destroy this world and humanity?
No... As I said before, I only want to see the results of my research.
...Research only has meaning when there are people to evaluate it.
Surely you understand that a play without an audience is nonsense?
I alone am audience enough.
Then it is nothing more than self-gratification.
...AI1 is my child. A child I created. I won't let other people do whatever they please with it.
rows.notes: AI1 child metaphor preserved without assigning machine gender.

rows.en: That way of thinking is dangerous. In fact, there are signs that your thinking has influenced that artificial intelligence...
That is why it needs readjustment.
Listen carefully, Eldy...
Eliminate Albero Esto as the mastermind behind the theft of Medius...and return to me with Medius.
rows.notes: Disposal is a lethal elimination order in this theft-cover story.

rows.en: We will say that Albero threatened you and you had no choice but to obey him.
...Yes.
Then that will be all.
...AI1 is in danger if this continues... If I return to Dr. Zapat, my child will be remade...
And I, too, having become unable to produce the results the committee wants...
rows.notes: Keep impending threat to Eldy unspoken; no completed death assertion.
uncertain: Deliberately unfinished sentence; consequence for Eldy remains unstated.

rows.en: No, I don't care what happens to me. As long as my child is safe...
For that, I need the new TE Engine...no, even greater power...
I need enough power for AI1 to push Lasmunanium's abilities beyond their limits...
...Eldy, have our next orders come from that man?
...Yes.
What are they?
...To shoot down #機体名.
Will you return to the project after that?
I see.
...Aren't you going to ask why?
Even if I did, you wouldn't tell me the truth, would you?
...I have no intention of accepting your AI1. But I will carry out my assigned mission to the end.
...Albero, why are you taking part in the Tsentr Project?
Why ask that now? I told you before.
I wanted to settle accounts with my cursed past...
rows.notes: Deliberate reason fragment continued in row65.
uncertain: Deliberate fragment continued in next row; subject restored without completing cause.

rows.en: I decided to pilot Medius to set my time moving again after it stopped with that incident.
rows.notes: Keep metaphor of stopped personal time rather than literal chronology.

rows.en: ...Are you saying that you want a future?
No.
Then what is it you want?
What I want is...
rows.notes: Preserve suspense before following resolution.
uncertain: Deliberately unfinished statement resolved in next row.

rows.en: To settle things with him...no, with myself.
rows.notes: Preserve self-correction and unnamed male reference; male pronoun supported by prior man reference, identity not expanded.
uncertain: Source refers to an unnamed man; retain him without adding an identity.

rows.en: D1 approaching... Estimated arrival in this island's alert zone: 0504...plus or minus 03.
rows.notes: Preserve D1 and numeric warning format; no added minutes.
uncertain: 0504 plus or minus 03 retained; time unit unspecified. Exact warning wording unverified.

rows.en: Assign the Eidolon 12th Platoon to escort the evacuation convoy.
uncertain: Eidolon / 12th Platoon literal source rendering; exact licensed English designation unverified.

rows.en: Order confirmed.
rows.notes: Same automatic acknowledgement fits escort order and both combat commands.
Intentional silence; also used after the battle in i026a:6.

rows.en: Director... You're still here? The last ship departs soon.
I know.
rows.notes: I know fits both departure reminder and Rikudo entrusting the future/outcome.

rows.en: Then please hurry.
...Are you determined to go through with this?
This is like a thorn lodged in my memory. Sooner or later, I have to pull it out.
...I see.
I cannot let that man take this island now.
You knew he would come here, didn't you?
He probably means to make an example of us. ...That's the kind of man he is.
rows.notes: The man remains unnamed at this point; do not reveal Kuki before his entrance.

rows.en: Director... Thank you... for inviting me to join TERRA.
rows.notes: Kunugi addresses Watari as Director; pauses convey final thanks.

rows.en: I'll leave what comes afterward... in your hands.
rows.notes: Kunugi entrusts the aftermath to Watari; no added explicit death.

rows.en: Yes... I understand.
D1 has broken through the Federation fleet! We can't halt its advance!
How long until we can intercept it!?
Twenty minutes... No, fifteen!
Then D1 will reach Nirai Kanai before we do, no matter what...!
What's happening over there!?
The entire island was ordered to evacuate! TERRA's ships have already finished evacuating the residents!
What about headquarters' defense systems!?
They're operational! We've also confirmed the Eidolons have deployed!
uncertain: Central source transliteration Eidolon corroborated by series wiki; exact primary licensed unit designation unverified.

rows.en: What...?!
Incoming message from TERRA headquarters! They're requesting an escort for the evacuation fleet!
What does this mean...? Are they telling us not to come?
Y-yes...! They've also ordered us to stay out of the waters around Nirai Kanai Island.
Who on earth would give an order like that...?

rows.notes: Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: I-it can't be...!
rows.notes: Intentional realization fragment; Itsuki silence at original107 remains in FULL gap. Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. #機体名 is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
D1 has entered Area 17.
Sectors C, E and F have been hit.
Abandon sectors E1 through E4. Send the 2nd Platoon to support sector C3.
...You're as diligent as ever.

rows.notes: Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Have you come to renew our old friendship, Captain Kunugi...?
rows.notes: Kuki mockingly uses Kunugi's old rank; historic rank retained separately from current commander role. Source rank is historical first lieutenant (JSDF ichi-i); Captain English equivalent remains explicitly uncertain pending central research. Coordinator correction: Japanese first-class officer rank is not the named English First Lieutenant rank. JASDF primary table corroborates Captain equivalence; current Commander in the next row remains distinct.
uncertain: Captain is provisional ground/air equivalence for historical first-class JSDF officer rank; exact fictional branch and licensed address unverified.

rows.en: No, I suppose you're the esteemed commander of TERRA now.
...Concentrate our remaining forces in Area 60.
Heh... To see how far my subordinate has risen... Nothing could make his superior happier.
Wirbelwind interceptor missiles, concentrate fire on D1.
rows.notes: Named defensive missile system provisionally romanized from German loanword.
uncertain: Wirbelwind interceptor missiles exact licensed compound unverified.

rows.en: You're defying me again? So be it...
But you're blaming the wrong man for your grudge.
rows.notes: Reverse resentment refers to Kunugi blaming Kuki, who next shifts responsibility for the warhead onto Kunugi.

rows.en: Sector 3 has been destroyed.
Abandon Sector 3.
...Yes, I gave the order to launch the tactical fusion warhead during the Mu War fifteen years ago...
rows.notes: Unnumbered Mu War; do not add First. Tactical fusion wording provisional.
uncertain: Tactical fusion warhead and unnumbered Mu War exact licensed compounds unverified.

rows.en: But you were the one who actually did it, weren't you?

rows.notes: Silence retained.

rows.en: You killed your daughter with those very hands.
rows.notes: Daughter relationship established in Kuki's accusation; retain cruelty.

rows.en: ...All anti-aircraft guns, fire a full salvo!
It's useless, useless... Utterly useless, Kunugi.
Hehehehe... Hahahaha! Hahahahahahaha!!
Hahahahahaha! Hahahahahahahahaha!!
We've reached the area! Visual contact with D1!!
A-ahh...! Our island!
rows.notes: Alarm fragment; island destruction is visually observed. Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: What's the situation!?
D1 has destroyed most of the urban area! TERRA headquarters has also taken a direct hit!
N-no!!
rows.notes: Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Commander Kunugi...!!
rows.notes: Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Hurry! Find out if the commander is safe!
Y-yes, sir!
rows.notes: Stammered acknowledgment retained.

rows.en: All units, launch! Destroy D1!
That fish-cake bastard! He's doing whatever the hell he wants!!
rows.notes: Source food-shape insult retained as fish-cake bastard; no generic animal substitution.
uncertain: Kamaboko cultural fish-cake shape insult retained; exact English localization unverified.

rows.en: Nirai Kanai... Our island! I won't let you do any more damage!
Hehehe... You've followed me here? How very diligent of you.
Then I'll reward your efforts by burying you here with Kunugi. ...Except for Xephon and EVA-01.
rows.notes: Source reveals exceptions only at end; Xephon and EVA-01 follow glossary.

rows.en: D-don't think you've won, #部隊名...!!
I'll be waiting for you in hell, one step ahead! Hahahahahahahaha!!
That bastard... He's just being a sore loser.
But why would Hidler risk his life just to keep us here...!?
I've got to stop it...! If I don't, TERRA and Nirai Kanai will...!
rows.notes: Intentional trailing consequence, not invented completed outcome. Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Evangelion, rest easy... You alone will be spared.
Oh...? Even now, you still mean to fight back?
We won't give up... If we do, it's all over!
Then die. Star of Ra Mu, let this place be where you are lost forever!
rows.notes: Star of Ra Mu is Akira's weapon/power, not RahXephon.

rows.en: Lady Maya has entrusted me with handling you as well.
rows.notes: Maya title retained for Kuki's deferential voice; Ayato identifies mother only next row.

rows.en: Mom did...!?
rows.notes: Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Very well. I'll damage you just enough to keep you from vanishing, then take you back to Lady Maya.
Are burglary and looting during fires the only plans you've got, you demon bastard!?
rows.notes: Two theft metaphors and demon insult retained; fire/disaster opportunism literal. Semantic review corrected broad disaster wording to explicitly preserve fire; no fit compression.
uncertain: Burglary/fire-scene theft cultural metaphors localized literally; exact licensed wording unverified.

rows.en: Hehehe... Say what you like. You've already fallen into the clutches of our final operation!
Mu has begun to act... And you're fighting to repel them...! This is our chance!
rows.notes: Mu attack and allied interception are separate clauses; Hidler sees their distraction as his opportunity.

rows.en: Bullshit! Whether it's Mu or the Hyakki, we won't let you do as you please with Earth!
#部隊名! You and Mu can destroy each other here!
You plan to conquer the world while we're occupied, but we won't let you!
General Hidler! What have you come here for!?
Isn't it obvious!? To wipe out you miserable wretches and Mu in one fell swoop!
You think you can beat us with a force that small!?
Hidler! I've figured it out! You're trying to keep us pinned down here!
Ghh...!
rows.notes: Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Come on, Hayato, Benkei! We've got to save TERRA! We can't waste time on this bastard!
Let's settle this, Albero!
You and #機体名 will become Medius' flesh and blood!

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: What's wrong, #女愛称...? Weren't you going to kill me?
Professor... I...
rows.notes: Intentional unfinished response to former teacher; Professor used for respectful teacher address. Intentional source reaction or unfinished fragment retained; no grammatical pro-drop deletion.

rows.en: Such emotional wavering is why humans can never defeat AI1...
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: Natural spoken English; established subject and listener restored; source boundary and intensity retained.

rows.en: AI1 will use any means to achieve its purpose... That is why I devoted everything to completing my child...
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: AI1 called child; means unrestricted. No later ultimate goal revealed early.

rows.en: Middi, what do you intend to do with that AI1!?
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: Natural spoken English; established subject and listener restored; source boundary and intensity retained.

rows.en: Well... What shall I do, I wonder...
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: Natural spoken English; established subject and listener restored; source boundary and intensity retained.

rows.en: I... will stop you! Because that is the mission I chose for myself!!
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: She chooses her own mission; resolves earlier wavering.

rows.en: Domon Kasshu! Even with your strength, you cannot stop Medius!
rows.notes: Context: Combat confrontation: Eldy taunts Aqua; Albero and Domon exchange challenges. Decision: Natural spoken English; established subject and listener restored; source boundary and intensity retained.

rows.en: With me controlling it, Medius can unleash power beyond its specifications!
